verdict.rationale: The official quickstart documents a self-serve path: sign up at console.x.ai, load credits, and create an API key on the API Keys page. The same guide includes a runnable first request in curl, Python and JavaScript, and no sales contact is required. Published self-serve pricing and spend tiers starting at $0 support the no-sales-call claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the signup and key-minting flow, and the requirement to prepay credits before first use is a minor friction point.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign up and mint an API key self-serve — no sales call, no waitlist gymnastics — and the docs say exactly how

citations.quote: Sign up for an account at console.x.ai, then load it with credits to start using the API. ... Create an API key via the API Keys page, then export it or add it as an environment variable
